items.headline: Banks hit concentration limits on data-center debt, pushing exposure to pension funds and insurers
items.note: Banks are hitting exposure caps to the same handful of hyperscale tenants, forcing more AI data-center debt into the less-regulated 144A/private-credit channel held by pensions and insurers.

items.headline: SEC exempts data-center bonds from key asset-backed-securities rules, easing debt issuance
items.note: Removing risk-retention and disclosure requirements for a class of data-center securitizations lowers the bar for issuance just as the sector's debt load is drawing credit scrutiny.

items.headline: Oracle-led hyperscaler CDS spreads hit fresh records; Oracle's 5-year CDS at 215bp, up 70bp YTD
items.note: Oracle's CDS spread widened past the 2008-crisis peak with Meta and Broadcom also hitting record levels, a broad-based credit-market signal of rising AI financing risk beyond a single name.

items.headline: AI debt indigestion forces Wall Street to rethink bond sales as ~80% of data-center securities trade wider than issuance
items.note: Broad-based secondary-market spread widening across data-center debt sold since early 2025 signals waning investor appetite after the year's fundraising surge.

items.headline: CMBS investors push back on AI-linked data-center debt; CyrusOne and QTS deals had to widen pricing to clear
items.note: Two of the last three data-center-backed commercial mortgage bonds needed repricing to attract buyers, a concrete sign of spread widening spreading into the CMBS corner of AI credit.

items.headline: SoftBank's AI funding plans face reckoning: $30B of obligations due in H2 2026 plus a $40B bridge loan maturing March 2027
items.note: Lenders are wary of using SoftBank's OpenAI stake as loan collateral, and its margin-loan LTV against Arm shares is running well above SoftBank's own reported ratio, tightening the path to fund its AI commitments.
